desc:
You know, I'd really like to hear the information from Hell's side. I mean, all information about the Hōrai Elixir is essentially from the Lunarian side. But how about the other side? Are you really free from death?

What does Hell think of it? It's impure, so no doubt even Eirin wouldn't know much about what goes on there. Maybe the kishin have already figured out several ways to claim a Hōrai soul.
